launch._note: auto_publish=true makes launch.py click Save with no human review. Opt-in only. Hard-capped per day and logged in data/foundry.db. itch.io forbids automated mass page production; one distinct tool per launch, human-reviewed by default, is what keeps this account healthy.

itch._comment: Set your itch.io username here. The API key goes in the BUTLER_API_KEY environment variable, never in this file.

tools.title: Delve — Procedural Dungeon Map Generator
tools.tagline: Infinite, shareable dungeons in one click. Deterministic seeds, four palettes, PNG and tile-grid export.
tools._launch_note: launch_mode 'free' = strict No payments on itch.io, donations OFF. Required while no adult operates the account payout side: even pay-what-you-want or donations can receive money, and receiving money is what itch's processors restrict to 18+. Flip to 'pwyw' at 18 or once an adult handles payouts.
tools._ai_note: Deliberately contains no neural-network output: all geometry comes from a self-contained deterministic algorithm (seeded PRNG + rejection sampling + MST). Under itch.io's quality guidelines this does NOT require a generative-AI tag. Keep it that way.

tools.title: Weave — Procedural Seamless Texture Generator
tools.tagline: Tileable PBR textures from a seed: albedo, normal, roughness, height. Seams are impossible -- the noise lattice is periodic.
tools._niche_note: Chosen by scout v2 on 2026-09-11: demand tag 'textures' = 2,369 results with 14 paid at $12.52 median; supply tag 'texture-generator' = 0. Strongest gold-rush gap measured.

tools.title: PEAL — Procedural Sound Effects Lab
tools.tagline: Seed-driven DSP: impacts, UI clicks, explosions, lasers, pickups, creature voices, creaks, whooshes, loopable ambience. Offline render, plain 16-bit WAV out, 8-variation packs zipped in-browser.
tools._niche_note: Chosen 2026-09-11 per docs/INDUSTRY-DEMAND-2026-09.md: universal demand (every game needs SFX; Unity revenue guides call audio 'steady predictable income'), emptiest competition (2009-era jsfxr toys vs subscription AI clouds).

tools.title: TABLEFORGE — Procedural Battle Maps for Game Masters
tools.tagline: Seeded top-down battle maps in four environments -- caverns, crypts and sewers, sci-fi stations, forest clearings. Square grid, named points of interest, VTT-sized PNG exports.
tools._niche_note: Vertical #4 per docs/INDUSTRY-DEMAND-2026-09.md: tabletop = itch's 2nd most active community (18.3k projects, +135/wk); paid-tool willingness proven (Arkenforge, Dungeondraft); generator seat on the free shelf nearly empty.
